rules.css: .visually-hidden { overflow: hidden; clip: rect(1px, 1px, 1px, 1px); width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow-wrap: normal; position: absolute !important; }
.visually-hidden.focusable:active, .visually-hidden.focusable:focus { overflow: visible; clip: auto; width: auto; height: auto; position: static !important; }

rules.selector: article, aside, details, figcaption, figure, footer, header, hgroup, main, menu, nav, section, summary
rules.css: article, aside, details, figcaption, figure, footer, header, hgroup, main, menu, nav, section, summary { display: block; }
ul.menu { margin-left: 1em; padding: 0px; list-style: outside none; text-align: left; }

rules.selector: article, aside, figcaption, figure, footer, header, hgroup, main, nav, section
rules.css: article, aside, figcaption, figure, footer, header, hgroup, main, nav, section { display: block; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
a { color: rgb(0, 123, 255); text-decoration: none; background-color: transparent; }
.container { width: 100%; padding-right: 15px; padding-left: 15px; margin-right: auto; margin-left: auto; }
.row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-right: -15px; margin-left: -15px; }
h2 { color: rgb(134, 134, 134); font-family: georgia, times, serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: normal; line-height: 34px; }
a:link, a:visited { color: rgb(204, 153, 51); text-decoration: none; }
.layout-container { width: 100%; margin: 12px auto 20px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); box-shadow: rgb(170, 170, 170) 8px 10px 8px; }

.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu { background: url("/sites/commonwealth/themes/commonwealth/img/menu-bg.gif") 0px 0px no-repeat; height: 26px; margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 26px; width: 100%; position: relative; float: left; }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li { float: left; list-style: none; padding: 7px 0px; }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li:hover, .block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li.menu-item--active-trail { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li:last-child a { border-right-width: medium; border-right-style: none; border-right-color: currentcolor; }

.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li a { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); float: left; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; line-height: 12px; padding: 0px 40px; border-right: 1px solid rgb(255, 255, 255); }

.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu::after { width: 100%; content: ""; float: left; min-height: 30px; background: url("/sites/commonwealth/themes/commonwealth/img/submenu-bg.gif") 0px 100% repeat-x; }

.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li.menu-item--expanded.menu-item--active-trail ul.menu { display: block; background: transparent; height: 30px; line-height: 30px; padding: 0px 15px; position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 26px; width: 100%; float: left; }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li ul li { display: inline-block; float: none; padding: 0px; }

.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li ul li a { color: rgb(0, 68, 124); font-size: 12px; line-height: 30px; font-weight: normal; padding: 0px 10px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li ul li a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li ul::after { background: none; min-height: 0px; }
.content-top-right .field--name-field-left-side-links { background: rgb(178, 178, 178); width: 100%; float: left; height: 100%; padding: 40px 40px 30px; }
.content-top-right .field--name-field-left-side-links p { font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; padding: 0px 0px 25px; margin: 0px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); }

.content-top-right .field--name-field-left-side-links ul li a { background: rgb(0, 69, 124); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: block; font-family: georgia, times, serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 37px; text-align: center; }
.content-banner-color .banner-bg { width: 100%; height: 4px; background: red; display: block; }
.cw-content-section { padding: 25px 25px 25px 14px; font-family: verdana, arial, sans-serif; width: 100%; float: left; }
.cw-content-section .content-right-sec h2 { border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(204, 204, 204); line-height: 30px; margin: 0px 0px 20px; }
footer #footer p.links { margin: 5px 0px 0px; float: left; color: rgb(153, 153, 153); }
footer #footer p.links a { color: rgb(0, 68, 124); font-size: 11px; }
footer #footer p.copy { color: rgb(153, 153, 153); font-size: 11px; float: right; margin: 5px 6px 0px 0px; }

.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu { background: rgb(0, 69, 124); position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; z-index: 9; padding: 15px 10px; height: 0px; overflow: hidden; visibility: hidden; transition: 0.26s ease-in-out; }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li a { border-right-width: medium; border-right-style: none; border-right-color: currentcolor; font-size: 14px; padding: 7px 10px; display: block; width: 100%; }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li ul li a { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 13px; }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li.menu-item--expanded.menu-item--active-trail ul.menu { position: inherit; background: transparent; height: auto; padding: 0px 10px; }
.block-system-menu-blockmain ul.menu li ul li { display: block; float: left; padding: 0px; width: 100%; }
footer #footer p.links, footer #footer p.copy { width: 100%; margin-right: 0px; }
